steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Thunderbolt!

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Aaaagh...! My eyes!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Where are the casters?! Take out that Vouivre!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What's happening? There's more of them?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: How?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We're in a bad way. They've got way too much firepower.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Cut our losses and fall back before this gets any worse.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...I see you...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Augh!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Sniper! !

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Shit, where?!!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Forget it! Just run!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...You're not getting away.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Fall back! Quickly! Just run!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: They're running!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Sitrep!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You okay, Alexsandr?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Yeah, just a flesh wound.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Those guys are learning.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't let your guard down!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We've still got company.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ...That's close enough, friend.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I appreciate the help, but let's keep a comfy distance until we figure things out.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Relax. We mean you no harm.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We're a Rhodes Island field team! And you're holed up in a Rhodes Island safehouse.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We're responding to a distress call.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Please identify yourselves.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Calm down! I'm here to help.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's the Rhodes Islanders?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hey, the cavalry came after all!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Go get Mr. Occphen.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Rhodes Island Operator? Hooray! We're saved! We're saved! !

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: That's about the size of it.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: So those four mercenaries are the ones who set up these temporary defenses?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: I'm really sorry. They broke my communicator, and I couldn't protect the safehouse...

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: I wouldn't blame you if you fired me on the spot...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Don't worry, this old man doesn't have the power to fire anybody.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: And the way I see it, you held out this long all by yourself. That's pretty fantastic.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: If it weren't for you, these Infected would've met a much worse fate.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: How many are they?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Counting the doctor outside, forty-three. All Infected.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And the four mercenaries were protecting them all this time?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Mercenaries going out of their way to look after Infected. That's something you don't see every day.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Mercenaries who not only don't look down on them, but actively try to help them.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Maybe I'm being too paranoid, but where did these saints come from?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I think they may not realize.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: From the way they talk, I get the impression they were just protecting ordinary, innocent townsfolk.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I guess it's less that they don't discriminate against the Infected.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And more that they don't care about Oripathy.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But they don't look Infected at all?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I've never seen mercenaries like them. I've never heard of any 'Team Rainbow'.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They've got guns, but none of them look like Sankta?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Unless the Sankta figured out a way to hide their 'Fluorescent Lamps'...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: A non-Sankta mercenary group fully decked out with big guns like that is gonna be huge news.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Blacksteel R&D would go nuts if they heard about this.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Let's not talk about them like they're not here.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Regardless, they saved a Rhodes Island Operator and protected a bunch of Infected.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Until we have some evidence, we shouldn't be doubting their motives.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Our top priority is finding a solution to our predicament.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Let's talk to them.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: They've been in there for a while.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What do you think of this Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: I've been wondering about them.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: What kind of pharmaceutical company needs a safehouse full of military-grade hardware out on the edge of civilization?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: They've got enough arms and explosives to outfit a platoon.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: And the employees of this 'pharmaceutical company' all look like professional soldiers.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Either this world's doctors are armed to the teeth, or the pharmaceutical business is a front. Probably both.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: They're armed. But they looked well-trained and well-spoken.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's a night and day difference with the thugs we ran into before.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Maybe it's just me, but I get a real familiar vibe from them.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You know, I got that too.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: They're reasonable, civilized people, at least. Everything I saw before had me thinking this world was an apocalyptic, bandit-ridden hellscape.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I'm finished binding your wound, Mr. Alexsandr.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Thanks, Doctor.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Doctor, are you familiar with this Rhodes Island organization?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ...I've heard a bit from the caravans.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: They're a group that specializes in critical care for the Infected, as well as an Oripathy research team.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: But isn't it an incurable disease?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Actually, there used to be a lot of people who claimed to be able to cure Oripathy.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: They were mostly shysters who ended up ruined when their scams were exposed.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: As for those who just exaggerated the effectiveness of their drugs suppressing the symptoms of Oripathy, they might not reach the level of fraud yet, but even their suppressant drugs are very expensive.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'd guess so.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I once heard about a lord whose daughter contracted Oripathy, and he spent a lot of money to buy the suppressants from Columbia to save his daughter.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Years later, the lord's money dried up, and his daughter died of the disease.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: But look at this.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: This is the safehouse's store of Oripathy suppressants.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: These past few days, I injected some of the more serious sufferers with this, and it really did suppress their symptoms. It works better than any drug I've ever seen before.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: This medicine... must be insanely expensive, no?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: But Mr. Occphen wasn't concerned with that at all. When I told him some of my patients were in critical condition, he gave me the box.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: It's not that I don't believe there are good people in this world, but...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hey, I didn't expect that.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't overthink it. Suspicion is costly. Whether you show it or not, it's going to get in the way of our talks with them.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It looks like our goals are aligned, so we can just lay this stuff on the table.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If you say so.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Oh, they're here.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Now let's skip the pleasantries.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Thank you for saving Occphen. Without you, Rhodes Island would have lost a good worker.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: When the mission is over, I'll make a full report, and Rhodes Island will remunerate you appropriately, and compensate you for your supplies.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Remuneration...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Remuneration is nice.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Also, you put your lives on the line for the Infected. And that wins this old man's admiration.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: These townsfolk have done a lot for us in our time here. Leaving them to die wouldn't be our style.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So you're mercenaries?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No... We're...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Yes. Yes we are.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: We're mercenaries. The super expensive kind.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Can you give us the name of your company? Mercenaries like you are a rare breed.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Err... We're... um...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Russian) Help me think of a name!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (Russian) Polar Bear Logistics?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I understand if you're not in a position to say.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: We're... We're from a faraway country in... in the south!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That's right! We're from way down south!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The south? South of Sargon? ?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Beyond the foehn hotlands?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Foehn...? Yes, the south. Right.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: There's other countries beyond the foehn hotlands? ?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: That's... shocking. I've lived a long time, and this is the first I've ever heard of people down there.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: In all the records of all the Lords Ameer, there's never been a single report of someone crossing the hotlands.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (Russian) You could've made your story a little more plausible.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Russian) Plausible like Polar Bear Logistics?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Anyway, warriors with Ursine and Victorian accents, it doesn't matter where you come from.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: You're willing to fight for the Infected. And at least on that point, our interests are aligned.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: At least for now, we can work together to deal with this situation.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I can agree with that.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: So who can tell us what the heck happened to this town?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Sarkaz Mercenary...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Controlling the monsters, should be casters.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: They're organized, disciplined, and most importantly, they know when to cut their losses and back down. They're not here for a quick raid.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They are all properly geared up with Columbian equipment. Some of them were extremely tough back when they sieged the safe house.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Judging from the equipments and tactics, they should be professional mercenaries who signed the 'Redmark contract.'

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I'm afraid it's a rebellion against the local lord.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But why are they attacking civilians?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: They chased us here from the Infected quarter.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What on Earth do these mercs actually want?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The most likely answer is they wanted to silence you.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm afraid that's not the only thing they were after.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: When they attacked the Infected quarter yesterday, they were obviously targeting the sick.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: They were trying to round them up.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm pretty sure that was their goal.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Kidnapping... Infected?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That doesn't make any sense.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The enemy's objectives are a mystery to us, but that's not the most important thing.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: For now, the best thing we can do is wait.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Wait?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: You may not realize it, but we're standing in the middle of a fait accompli.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: We walked into this Lord Ameer's territory without his permission, violating his commandments and the local laws. We've broken a major Sargon taboo.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The town nobility may be in the middle of a war, but they're still the rulers here.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Sticking our noses in anything else at this point would only make our situation even worse.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The local lord set up an Infected quarter. That tells us he's not totally cruel and heartless.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: He was willing to let Rhodes Island build a safehouse here. That means he's not an isolationist.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I think he'll treat us fairly.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: National law... local government... I get it. That's the best we can hope for right now.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Until the situation changes again, we'll hold out in the safehouse and wait for the riots to die down.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I hope you can help us.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No problem. We need Rhodes Island's professional expertise too.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: All right then. I'm looking forward to working with the four of you.
